_note: What the model is told about the data. Only the analytics views exist for it; base tables, users, sessions and the audit log are never described. Visibility per role trims this further before a prompt is built.

customers.description: One row per customer. Row-filtered by the asker's scope; PII columns are masked by the database according to the asker's tier.

region.description: The customer's CURRENT region (North, South, East, West). For revenue by region use orders.region, which is the region at the time of the order.

assigned_rep_id.description: The sales rep who owns the account (joins sales_reps.rep_id).

created_at.description: When the customer signed up. Use for 'new customers'.

full_name.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

email.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

phone.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

street_address.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

city.description: Quasi-identifier. Masked for the masked tier.

postal_code.description: Quasi-identifier. Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

date_of_birth.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it. Use age_band for age analysis.

orders.description: One row per order. Row-filtered by the asker's scope.

region.description: Region at the time of the order. Use this for revenue by region.

order_date.description: The business date. Use this for every period filter and revenue.

created_at.description: When the record was keyed (0-4 days after order_date). NOT the business date; do not use for periods.

status.description: completed, shipped, processing or cancelled. Revenue excludes cancelled.

total_amount.description: Order total in USD (sum of its lines).

order_items.description: One row per order line. Visible exactly when its order is.

unit_price.description: Price charged per unit. Line revenue = quantity * unit_price.

products.description: Product catalog. Product names are NOT unique across categories: group by product_id (and show name + category).

name.description: Display name; repeats across categories (e.g. 'Classic Tee').

category.description: Apparel, Footwear, Home, Kitchen, Electronics, Outdoor, Beauty, Kids.

sales_reps.description: Sales reps. Rep names and emails are employee PII and are masked by tier.

rep_name.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

rep_email.description: Masked unless the asker's tier allows it.

region_month_summary.description: Monthly aggregates per region, non-cancelled orders only. Groups with fewer than 10 orders or customers are suppressed. The only order-level source for the contractor role.

category_month_summary.description: Monthly aggregates per region and product category, non-cancelled orders only. Groups with fewer than 10 order lines are suppressed.

pii_visibility._note: What each tier can actually see in each PII column (the database enforces this; the agent uses it to decline requests a tier would only get redactions for).
